description: Java class implementing a builder for creating responses and events related to live modify commands for 'things' in the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: ModifyThingLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImpl
classes.description: Final class implementing a builder for creating command responses and events for modify live commands, with inner classes for response and event factories.

classes.name: ResponseFactoryImpl
classes.description: Immutable inner class providing methods to generate specific command responses and error responses.

classes.name: EventFactoryImpl
classes.description: Immutable inner class providing methods to generate event instances for created and modified 'things'.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new builder instance for a given command.

methods.name: doCreateResponse
methods.description: Creates a command response using the provided response factory function.

methods.name: doCreateEvent
methods.description: Creates an event using the provided event factory function.
